Write the new README.md, under 200 lines, in this order: (1) a centred hero -- `

`, `

faberun

`, a centred tagline `From intent to running software.`, and the CI badge `https://github.com/feliperun/faberun/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg` plus the latest-release badge `https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/feliperun/faberun` and the npm badge `https://img.shields.io/npm/v/faberun`; taskPacket.objective: docs/CONCEPTS.md states four invariants exactly as the code enforces them, and docs/GETTING-STARTED.md's first-campaign walkthrough commits the repository after `faberun init` so `faberun run` does not refuse a dirty tree -- closing the accuracy findings the phase-3 judges recorded.
instructions: The phase-3 judge accepted docs/CONCEPTS.md with four minor accuracy findings. Fix exactly these, changing no other content: (1) 'Attention and parked' lists `judge_fallback_vendor_conflict` as a campaign-level parked reason; it is a node-level attention code. The chain parks a campaign only with `run_parked` / `run_canceled` (a settled, unsuccessful run), `contract_validation_failed`, `contract_authored_bytes_changed`, `contract_digest_mismatch`, or a promotion refusal code (see `park(` call sites in src/campaign/chain.mjs); a node's `judge_fallback_vendor_conflict` appears only inside the run's own attention, which `run_parked` then names. (2) 'Promotion and the landing branch' says promotion 'is the only place a branch other than the per-run ref moves'; attempt branches (`refs/heads/faberun/<run>/<node>/<attempt>`) move on every seal commit and the candidate ref moves during integration (src/repo/worktree.mjs, src/repo/integrate.mjs). State the true invariant: promotion is the only place a shared landing branch moves, and the chain never force-updates it. (3) 'Tier, costRank and fallback' says 'a self-loop or cycle is rejected' without qualification; per skills/faberun/references/contract.md validation rejects a self-loop outright and walks for cycles only the fallback chain a gated worker reaches -- not a chain no gated worker reaches, nor a judge's chain. (4) 'Attention and parked' says `campaign unpark <id>` 'clears it only once the named run is no longer parked'; src/campaign/unpark.mjs refuses a still-parked or canceled run unless `--force` is passed, and clears the attention outright when the run directory no longer exists. State both.

Fifth fix, in docs/GETTING-STARTED.md: the first-campaign walkthrough runs `faberun init` (which edits .gitignore and adds .claude/skills/faberun) and then `faberun run --detach`, but `run` calls assertLaunchBaseClean (src/repo/source-identity.mjs): when the cwd HEAD is the base and the tree has any uncommitted path (the pathspec ignores only .runs, AGENTS.md and the contract file itself), it refuses with `dirty_work_tree`. Insert a step between 'Prepare a repository' and the run: commit the init changes (`git add -A && git commit -m "chore: prepare the repository for faberun"`) and keep the contract file outside the tree or committed too, with one sentence saying why (`run` cuts every worktree from HEAD and refuses to launch over uncommitted paths; `--base-ref <ref>` is the alternative when the base is another ref). Keep every other step as written.

Verify each corrected sentence against the cited source before writing it; quote the code's own vocabulary (error codes, ref names) exactly. Keep the document's structure, headings and every other sentence as they are.
Run `node --test test/docs/` yourself (file reads only; it spawns nothing) and report done.
decisions: Only the sentences the judges named change; the rest of CONCEPTS.md and GETTING-STARTED.md is untouched.
Every invariant is traceable to a cited file.
nonGoals: Do not restructure or expand the document.
Never run npm install in the worktree; never run the whole suite yourself.
